businessObjects.name: Customer Order Record
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To capture and maintain the definitive record of a customer's selection of goods, delivery address, and requested delivery time window for fulfillment.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the 'Shipt' app description which allows users to 'Order groceries' and receive 'same-day' delivery, indicating the creation of a specific order record with time constraints.

businessObjects.name: Payment Transaction
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To record the financial exchange between the customer and the platform, ensuring funds are transferred and settlement is processed to enable the business to proceed with fulfillment.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the availability of 'digital coupons, personalized offers' and the general operational requirement of 'instant settlement' described in payment infrastructure contexts to support on-demand transactions.

businessObjects.name: Fulfillment Order
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To represent the actionable instruction sent from the system to warehouse or store staff to pick and pack specific items for a specific order.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the general concept of 'order processing and fulfillment' and 'streamlining' processes where raw materials and supplies are managed to send out orders, adapted here for grocery items.

businessObjects.name: Delivery Order
businessObjects.businessPurpose: To track the logistics assignment, courier details, and final delivery status (e.g., 'express delivery') once the items are packed and leave the fulfillment center.
businessObjects.evidenceSummary: Inferred from the specific mention of 'Express Delivery' and 'same-day' delivery capabilities in the grocery context, requiring a distinct object to track the hand-off to the courier.
